🎬 Nightbitch (2024)

Nightbitch follows a former artist who puts her career on hold to become a stay-at-home mother, only to discover that motherhood is far more overwhelming and isolating than she ever imagined. Struggling with exhaustion, loneliness, and the loss of her personal identity, she begins experiencing strange physical and emotional changes that make her believe she might be transforming into a dog. As her behavior becomes increasingly unpredictable, she starts questioning whether these unusual experiences are real or simply the result of her frustrations. Through bizarre situations, dark humor, and emotional discoveries, she confronts the pressures of parenting, marriage, and society’s expectations of women. Starring Amy Adams, Nightbitch combines surreal fantasy, psychological drama, and dark comedy while exploring motherhood, identity, freedom, sacrifice, and self-discovery.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Horror • Fantasy

⭐ IMDb: 5.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 38m • R

🎥 Director: Marielle Heller

✍️ Writer: Marielle Heller, based on the novel by Rachel Yoder

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Nightbitch is a 2024 American black comedy body horror film written, produced and directed by Marielle Heller, based on the 2021 novel by Rachel Yoder. The film stars Amy Adams, Scoot McNairy, Arleigh Snowden, Emmett Snowden, Zoë Chao, Mary Holland, Archana Rajan, and Jessica Harper. Nightbitch premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 7, 2024, and was released theatrically in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on December 6, 2024. The film received mixed reviews from critics.
